title: Throw a typed ValidationException, not dart:core FormatException, from DataExportImportService.validateAndPreview
why: Every other domain exception in this batch (e.g. LastActiveCurriculumException) extends the project's AppException/ValidationException hierarchy in core/exceptions/app_exception.dart, letting callers catch by stable project type and letting presentation map to a localized message by type. validateAndPreview instead throws bare dart:core FormatException at 4 sites (463, 468, 474, 477), indistinguishable from the FormatException json.decode itself can throw two lines above -- a caller can't tell 'malformed JSON' from 'well-formed JSON missing a required section' without string-matching the message, and can't localize it the way the rest of the domain layer does.
recommendation: Introduce a typed exception (e.g. ImportValidationException extends ValidationException) and throw it in place of FormatException at all 4 sites; update the tests currently asserting throwsA(isA<FormatException>()).
acceptance_criteria: validateAndPreview/importData throw the new typed exception, not FormatException; existing malformed-import tests updated to assert the new type.

corrections: DataExportImportService (validateAndPreview/importData) has zero callers anywhere in lib/ outside itself — confirmed via repo-wide grep. The 'propagates to presentation, can't localize' framing is currently hypothetical since nothing calls it in production, but this doesn't change the P3 floor severity already assigned.
